lens: Recruitment operator — first encounter; simulated expertise/user lens
reason: The public proposition is clear and visually coherent with Precision Instrument; pending client approval is disclosed rather than replaced with invented outcomes. I traced the student path from Home through Join preparation to application intake and its original-resume disclosure, and the operator path from cohort selection through round coverage, deliberate close and batch-release recovery. Hidden selections, fixed advancement review, fresh close counts, explicit irreversible consequences, per-applicant blockers and separate email-delivery wording are strong safeguards. However, the first-encounter coverage list can call invalid partial work Complete, contradicting the more accurate results and closing surfaces. Fix that operational ambiguity before release. Supplied desktop/mobile close captures are synthetic; local tests and source inspection do not establish successful authenticated operation or observed user success.

findings.evidence: Coverage uses assignment statuses alone. groupCaseCoverageState (src/app/admin/group-case-coverage.ts:16-25) returns SUBMITTED for two submitted assignments; round-board.tsx:314-315 renders this as Complete and line 279 excludes it from need coverage. The supplied SQL fixture demonstrates two submitted Group Case observations with zero valid evaluations and one incomplete applicant (supabase/tests/round_close_summary.sql:78-83,98-101). Results already expose canonical valid counts separately.
findings.userImpact: An operator scanning Who still needs attention can treat partial or invalid work as finished and miss the applicant needing intervention. The closing dialog catches aggregate incompleteness later, but the operator must reconcile conflicting signals before an irreversible freeze.
findings.suggestedFix: Use canonical per-applicant validity for completion and attention ordering/counts. Keep assignment staffing as a separately named measure; label status-only completion All assigned forms submitted. Add a focused regression using two submitted partial observations to ensure this applicant remains visibly incomplete.

notVerified: No staging or hosted integration evidence exists for Clerk sessions, Supabase RPC/RLS, uploads or actual email delivery; supplied mocks and isolated SQL do not prove that chain.
No observed first-time operator or applicant task success, human study, or authenticated end-to-end cohort/close/release exercise. No tests were run during this review.

Private-screen visual evidence is limited to synthetic close-modal captures; complete dashboards, real cohort scale and release recovery were source-reviewed only. Mobile capture requires vertical scrolling; full keyboard and assistive-technology usability remain unknown.
Safari, Firefox, physical devices, client-approved artifacts/outcomes, Board resolution of resume-access policy and deployment/migration rollout remain unverified.
